title: Titumir's reformist and anti-oppression network expands
detail: Religious mobilization and rural organizing in parts of Bengal built a resistance base against exploitative local power and colonial backing.

title: Bamboo fort at Narkelberia becomes the rebellion's center
detail: Titumir's followers fortified Narkelberia with bamboo defenses and confronted Company-allied forces in a direct armed showdown.

title: A durable symbol of peasant-Muslim resistance
detail: Though suppressed militarily, the uprising endured in regional memory as a key chapter of anti-colonial rural defiance in Bengal.
